crossRefs.note: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not…
that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.
translations.bsb: So David and all the people with him got up and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, there was no one left who had not crossed the Jordan.
translations.kjv: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.
translations.asv: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over the Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over the Jordan.
